sourceTitle: How to make Schezwan Masala Pav
sourceText:
How to make Schezwan Masala Pav
By: ravikumar
Published: Sunday, September 10, 2017 - 11:16pm

Ingredients




3 tbsp Ching's Schezwan Chutney
2 Chopped Onion
1 tsp Chopped Garlic
2 Chopped Tomatoes
2 Chopped Capsicum
1 tsp Smith & Jones Ginger Garlic Paste
1 ½ tbsp Pav Bhaji Masala
1 tbsp Butter
8 Pieces Pav
1 tbsp Oil
2 tbsp Chopped Coriander

Preparation

1 Step 1: 2 Heat oil in a pan, add garlic, onion and sauté well. Add Smith n Jones ginger garlic paste and mix. 3 Step 2: 4 Add capsicum and sauté until capsicum is cooked. 5 Step 3: 6 Add tomatoes, salt and cook until tomatoes are soft. 7 Step 4: 8 Add Chings Secret Schezwan Chutney, pav bhaji masala and sauté. Now mash the masala and cook for some more time. 9 Step 5: 10 Add chopped coriander and remove the mixture in a bowl. 11 Step 6: 12 Slit the pav and add butter onto it and place the pav in the pan and toast the pav . 13 Step 7: 14 Stuff the pav with the prepared mixture and cook the pav in the pan until crisp. 15 Remove the serving plate and Serve

About

Make Easy Breakfast Schezwan Masala Pav at home for your loved ones. Schezwan Masala Pav Recipe is so Delicious and Tasty that everyone loves to eat.
